metadata.score_formula: EFI = Phi^-1( (p_fc - p_clim) / (1 - p_clim) ), with p_fc the percentile of the current value inside the reference distribution of the matching climatology group, p_clim the configured climatological percentile (default 0.9) and Phi^-1 the standard-normal quantile function. The ratio is clipped to [0, 1 - 1e-6] and the result to [EFI_MIN, EFI_MAX], so the score is bounded. Prototype implementation: deterministic (no ensemble), uncalibrated, and NOT an operational ECMWF EFI.

precip_era5.note: Prototype severity thresholds for the SIH26078 demo. They are NOT official warning thresholds (for example IMD criteria) and are not calibrated for real weather data.
